Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Main Street core with the Medford City Hall, the Rogue Credit Union, and the mixed-use permitting corridor along Riverside Avenue.

Medford Center.name: Medford Center
Medford Center.description: Crater Lake Highway midtown corridor with the Medford Center mall, big-box retail, and the city's highest commercial permit velocity.

East Medford.name: East Medford
East Medford.description: East of I-5 along McAndrews Road with master-planned subdivisions, Blackthorn Drive residential infill, and the Rogue Valley Medical Center adjacency.

McAndrews Corridor.name: McAndrews Corridor
McAndrews Corridor.description: E McAndrews Road commercial strip with tenant-improvement remodels, auto dealerships, and the Medford Town Center retail node.

South Medford.name: South Medford
South Medford.description: South Central Avenue corridor with post-war single-family stock, the Stewart Meadows golf community, and steady replacement-permit activity.

Stewart Meadows.name: Stewart Meadows
Stewart Meadows.description: Stewart Meadows / Roxy Ann Peak foothills edge with newer residential subdivisions, golf-course views, and the Foothills Christian Church node.

North Medford.name: North Medford
North Medford.description: North Medford along N Keene Way Drive with CRATER LAKE AVE intersections, residential subdivisions, and the Rogue Valley International Airport edge.

Airport Edge.name: Airport Edge
Airport Edge.description: Biddle Road industrial corridor and Rogue Valley International-Medford Airport perimeter with light-industrial and aviation-support permitting.

Riverside.name: Riverside
Riverside.description: Bear Creek greenway corridor with the Riverside Park, Hawthorne Park, and the pre-war bungalow stock along the east-side streamside.

Central Point.name: Central Point
Central Point.description: Central Point town center at the junction of I-5 and OR-99 with the Jackson County Expo Park, the North Medford industrial edge, and Crater Rock Museum.

Jacksonville.name: Jacksonville
Jacksonville.description: Historic Jacksonville town west of Medford with the Britt Music & Arts Festival, Britta Road wine-tourism, and the Applegate Valley growth edge.
